svg.title: DJ Sample: The Crate Archaeologist
svg.desc: Record sleeve drawn from the library: rings are decades, 1970s inside to 2020s outside; segments are BPM bands; the brighter the cell, the more tracks. Biggest lanes: 122-127 BPM, 9 tracks; 100-109 BPM, 7 tracks; 119-122 BPM, 6 tracks.
